findings.issue: טַף (H2945) is a collective singular, the little ones; «nuestro niño» is one child.
הַמִּבְצָר is absolute, so the chain ends at the fortification. מִפְּנֵי starts a new phrase, from before the inhabitants, and is not a genitive «de faces» of the fortress.
Niphal חלץ (H2502) leaves open arm/equip oneself and draw off or withdraw; «nos extraeremos» keeps only extract/draw out.
Qal ישב leaves open sit, dwell, and remain; «se sentará» resolves it to sitting.

notes: «hasta que si» and «los hayamos traído» keep עד אשר אם and the hiphil perfect with its 3mp suffix.
